reviewItem.question: Does "loki do not wrap requests but send pure Protobuf from frontend v2 via scheduler to querier when `-frontend.encoding=protobuf`. 10956" mean a change to cli-flag:loki|name=-frontend.encoding (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: When -frontend.encoding=protobuf is set, Loki frontend v2 now sends pure Protobuf requests via the scheduler to the querier instead of wrapping them.
